newsitem.title: ESTONIA: KUNDA CEMENT TO ISSUE CPS, OTHERS TO COME.
newsitem.headline: KUNDA CEMENT TO ISSUE CPS, OTHERS TO COME.

text.p: Kunda Nordic Cement will issue its first commercial papers on June 27 worth 20 million kroons, Hansapank said on Tuesday.
The yield for three-month commercial papers is 8.5 percent, Hansapank's interest rate products manager, Ulo Kallas, told Reuters.
Kallas added the company has signed an agreement for one year to issue commercial papers up to 100 million kroons.
Tallinn Port will on June 13 issue 50 million kroons in CPs. The three-month commercial papers have a yield of 7.5 percent.
Tallinn Port will also issue 30 million kroons of three-month commercial papers with a yield of 7.35 percent on June 25.
Hansa Leasing will issue three-month commercial papers worth 40 million kroons on June 17. The yield for the papers is 7.25 percent.
